pages.title: Heavy Laser Turret
pages.text: $(br2)A heavy turret that fires a wide laser capable of destroying any block in its path.$(br2)Functions only on a subspace.

The severe performance cost of ultra-long-range ray tracing has not yet been solved, so this turret currently supports only Automatic mode.$(br2)Extremely effective against hostile subspaces.$(br2)Maximum targeting distance/range: 256 blocks.
